Petitioner :- Smt Veena Devi
Respondent :- State Of U.P. And 3 Others

Counsel for Petitioner :- Pradeep Kumar,Sheo Ram Singh
Counsel for Respondent :- C.S.C.,Ishan Deo Giri

Hon'ble Manoj Kumar Gupta,J.
Hon'ble Anish Kumar Gupta,J.

1. The petitioner has prayed for a direction to respondent no.2 to pay compensation to her for plot
no. 1109 kha area 0.08 hectare of village Gotha Pargana Satasi, Tehsil- Bisauli, District Budaun.

2. In paragraph-8 of the writ petition, it is stated that notification under Section 6(1) of the Land
Acquisition Act was issued in the newspaper on 08.01.2021.
Smt Veena Devi vs State Of U.P. And 3 Others on 26 May, 2025

entities.text: Veena Devi vs State Of U.P. And 3 Others
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
Copy of the extract of the alleged notification does not indicate that under which provision of law,
the acquisition was made.
It is also not clear to counsel for the petitioner.

As the petitioner claims right to receive compensation on basis of a sale deed, it would not be possible for this Court to ascertain the claim unless the provision of law under which acquisition is being made, is clarified and the acquisition notifications are brought on record.
4. The writ petition is dismissed with liberty to file a better petition.

Order Date :- 26.5.2025 Ashish Pd.
(Anish Kumar Gupta,J.) (Manoj Kumar Gupta,J.)
